objective: DESIGN LANE. Convert open ICPERF ideas into hypothesis and experiment contracts, disjoint from BATCH-a33cda (the point-decomposition instrument repair). AGENTS.md ECC instruction 3 makes an open ECC idea ranked work to be designed, not shelved: tools/ecc_priority.py --open-ideas lists 8 open ICPERF ideas and DEC-20260916-3c0cf5 ranks all 8, designs the top 3, approves the one whose protocol is complete and whose inputs exist, and records enumerated approval preconditions plus one impediment for the other two. This lane launches NO trial and writes no experiment implementation code. Designing is not approving; approving is not dispatching.
max_concurrent_basis: Machine headroom and archive isolation, not a research budget. The only task in this queue is an archival commit, and AGENTS.md requires commit tasks to run ALONE in the worktree. GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4's campaign_budget.max_concurrent is 2 and BATCH-a33cda holds the other slot; this lane takes one. Unlike that lane, nothing here is a timing measurement, so this lane does not require and does not compete for a quiet host -- every primary metric in all three contracts designed here is a load-invariant count.

notes.text: This queue IS the batch record; there is no batch.yaml, matching BATCH-51e2aa and BATCH-a33cda in this goal, which also have none. The opening and operative decision is DEC-20260916-3c0cf5 and it carries the full ranking of all eight open ICPERF ideas, the selection of three, the pairing of pre-allocated identifiers to ranks, the approval of one contract, and the recorded impediment IMP-1. No separate opening-report.md is written: the decision record is the human-readable account and duplicating it would create a second copy of a ranking that must not drift.

DISJOINT FROM BATCH-a33cda ON THREE AXES, DELIBERATELY. (1) WRITE SCOPE: no task here reads or writes ledger/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/goal.yaml, coordination/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/batches/BATCH-a33cda/, coordination/review/icperf-20260915-a33cda/, experiments/EXP-ICPERF-e21835/, experiments/EXP-ICPERF-13f001/ or experiments/EXP-ICPERF-66fd51/. This lane's state lives in ledger/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/checkpoints/BATCH-94168f.yaml, a write-once shard, and in the already-committed lane file. (2) SOFTWARE: none of the three contracts designed here uses a Groebner engine, so none depends on the instrument under repair; EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40's exhaustive table IS the UNSAT certificate the Groebner column would have supplied. (3) MACHINE HEADROOM: every primary metric designed here is a count (table entries, root classes, agreement counts, WDSat conflicts and decisions), and counts are invariant under load, so no contract here needs the quiet host BATCH-a33cda's timing benchmarks require. The stated cost of (3): these contracts contribute nothing to the seconds-valued columns of RQ-ICPERF-94c86e, which stay owed to batches that can hold the machine quiet. A third lane -- H-ICPERF-5f038b / EXP-ICPERF-025a52, descent as a DAG, approval withheld by DEC-20260915-d8d413 -- may resume at any time without this session being told; nothing here touches its records either.

NO IDENTIFIER WAS MINTED BY THIS LANE. Every identifier used (BATCH-94168f, DEC-20260916-3c0cf5, H-ICPERF-afe62e, H-ICPERF-81de5c, H-ICPERF-f08b1e, EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40, EXP-ICPERF-61c136, EXP-ICPERF-42ef30, TASK-20260916-ec9948) was supplied pre-allocated and --check verified. The consequence, disclosed rather than worked around: the coordinator DESIGN act that produced this package has no queued card, because only the archival TASK identifier was allocated. Its output is owned by exactly one archival task, which is the binding requirement of AGENTS.md 'Durable research commits'. Executor and reviewer cards for the three contracts do not exist, so EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40 is APPROVED BUT NOT DISPATCHABLE.

TASK-20260916-ec9948 is a SNAPSHOT archive, following the precedent this goal set for a design package (TASK-20260915-6d72a0, which archived DEC-20260915-428a17 and eight sibling design records as a snapshot at f4f2dfa80). A LEDGER archive binds evidence records and the transitions they support; this batch composed no evidence record and moved no hypothesis on evidence. The ledger archive is owed later, after a producer has run and been independently reviewed, and will be a separate card. This queue file is committed in the same commit but is NOT hash-bound as an artifact_path, for the fixed-point reason BATCH-a33cda recorded against TASK-20260915-1942e2: a queue that records its own task's state transition cannot have its post-commit bytes declared before the commit that changes them.

ADDED BY DEC-20260916-a91144, WHICH DISPATCHES NOTHING. Three cards join the queue and the lane stops being design-only: TASK-20260916-3355fc (executor, implement AND run EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40 under C-INDEP), TASK-20260916-2c4679 (coordinator, snapshot archive owning 3355fc's deliverables, before any reviewer reads them), and TASK-20260916-8d493b (coordinator, snapshot archive owning the dispatch package itself, BEFORE the executor is launched from it). The identifier_discipline note above recorded the gap this closes -- 'EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40 is APPROVED BUT NOT DISPATCHABLE' because no executor handoff existed. It is now written; it is still not dispatched, and it is not dispatchable until TASK-20260916-ec9948 and TASK-20260916-8d493b have both committed, verified and pushed. Writing a card and launching it are two acts by two sessions.

max_concurrent STAYS 1 AND THE ORIGINAL BASIS ABOVE IS LEFT AS WRITTEN rather than rewritten, even though its first clause ('the only task in this queue is an archival commit') is no longer true of the queue's contents. The value is unchanged for two independent reasons: archive commits still run ALONE in the worktree (AGENTS.md 'Durable research commits'), and the one non-archival task, TASK-20260916-3355fc, must not run beside an archive of its own outputs. GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4's campaign max_concurrent is 2; as of 2026-09-16T08:28Z BATCH-a33cda holds one live claim (TASK-20260915-abf147, validator; TASK-20260915-3f4b52 was RELEASED completed at 08:15:58Z), leaving one slot, and this lane takes it. That is a READING, not a reservation: re-derive it at dispatch with `git fetch` and `tools/research_dispatch.py --claims refs`.

THREE ARCHIVAL CARDS, EACH OWNING A DISJOINT RECORD SET, RUNNING ALONE AND STRICTLY IN SEQUENCE: ec9948 (the nine design records) -> 8d493b (DEC-20260916-a91144 and the three new cards) -> [dispatch 3355fc] -> 2c4679 (the executor's code tree, run directory and task receipt). No record has two archival owners and none has zero. All three also-stage THIS FILE without hash-binding it, for the fixed-point reason recorded above; that staging overlap is not a concurrency hazard because archives run alone and in order. The LEDGER archive -- binding an evidence record, a closing decision and any KN-FIND -- is owed after independent review and needs identifiers this lane does not hold.

tasks.title: Implement the EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40 enumerator, classifier and certified-target sampler UNDER C-INDEP in a FRESH session, then execute the frozen contract once
tasks.review_required_note: CLAIM-RELEVANT PRODUCER. Its output becomes the certificate basis for every later ICPERF point-decomposition measurement, so a defect here propagates into evidence that would look sound. An independent round with a review_plan written BEFORE any reviewer runs is owed before any evidence record is composed. That plan is NOT written: it needs at least three reviewer identifiers (J1/J3 sighted, J2 blind, J4 C-INDEP verification) and this lane holds none. Recorded as IMP-2 on DEC-20260916-a91144.
tasks.read_scope_exclusions_note: C-INDEP's five file names resolved to seven exact paths (binec.py and convert.py each exist twice). Reading any of them fires the contract's invalidation rule and the run is INVALID. Reading the OUTPUTS of val_gf2n.py -- the five committed C-RECON baseline JSON artifacts -- is REQUIRED, not forbidden: the comparison target is data, the program is code. The Weil_descent program may be INVOKED for AR-2; its source may not be opened.
tasks.write_scope_exclusivity: EXCLUSIVE. No other task in any open lane of GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4 writes these three paths. experiments/EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40/specification.yaml is NOT writable and must stay byte-identical to its committed state.
tasks.artifact_paths_note: Three exact subtrees. The run directory is experiments/EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40/runs/<RUN-ID>/ and the RUN identifier is minted BY THE EXECUTOR with `python3 tools/allocate_id.py --next run --area ICPERF` then `--check`, because this lane was allocated no run identifier and must never hand-pick a token. The subtree is exact -- it is empty today and the contract sets maximum_runs 1 -- and TASK-20260916-2c4679 binds every file beneath it by enumerated sha256.
tasks.inference_note: independent_session_required is TRUE on this card while the frozen contract's own inference block reads false. DELIBERATE AND DISCLOSED: the contract's field is the experiment's inference requirement, this one is the dispatch envelope's, and it is the mechanism by which C-INDEP -- a control the contract FROZE -- is discharged on this runtime. It strengthens the dispatch and relaxes nothing; no control, metric, budget, stopping rule, invalidation rule or success criterion is altered, so this is not a protocol amendment and the contract is not edited.
tasks.budget_note: maximum_runs 1 is the contract's HARD scientific constraint (one run DIRECTORY, not one invocation); the per-invocation timeouts are the contract's and are separate (WDSat default 600 s, WDSat all-solutions 600 s, CryptoMiniSat 600 s, enumerator per (cell,side) 3600 s). memory_gb 4 is the contract's machine-protection cap. wall_clock_seconds is an explicitly justified process WATCHDOG, and the contract's stopping rules already define behaviour at expiry: stop, keep every completed table and the partial results.jsonl, run the reduction, record which phases finished. Expiry CHECKPOINTS the task; it never exhausts the campaign and is never evidence.
